description: Drag-to-reschedule math. A case grabs `event` at `grabHit` (null = no hit) via grabFor, then runs computeDropRange for every hit in `hits`; `drops` is keyed "<zone> <day> <minutes>" and holds null when the drop is refused or a no-op, else the new { start, end } range. `previewId` is the id makeDragPreview gives the stand-in. Also edgeScrollDelta and the constants.
